### create detail, units & data columns of sample columns

```{r}
# break up the "sample" column in the database into 4 columns that contain the 
# 2-character strings describing the samples collected for a given individual
NZNBBS_Template_T16 <- 
  as.data.table(NZNBBS_Template_T15.5)
NZNBBS_Template_T16[, sample := gsub("\\s+", "", sample)]
NZNBBS_Template_T16[, sample := gsub("BF", "FB", sample)]
NZNBBS_Template_T16[, sample := gsub("PF", "FP", sample)]
NZNBBS_Template_T16[, c("col1", "col2", "col3", "col4") := tstrsplit(sample, ",", fixed = TRUE)]


NZNBBS_Template_T17 <-
  NZNBBS_Template_T16 %>%
  # if no data in a column, then NA
  mutate(col1 = ifelse(col1 == "", NA, col1)) %>% 
  mutate(col2 = ifelse(col2 == "", NA, col2)) %>%
  mutate(col3 = ifelse(col3 == "", NA, col3)) %>% 
  mutate(col4 = ifelse(col4 == "", NA, col4)) %>%
         # if a Q is detected, then it must be a Queen's blood sample
  mutate(queens = ifelse(str_detect(col1, "Q") | str_detect(col2, "Q") | str_detect(col3, "Q") | str_detect(col4, "Q"), "yes", "no"),
         # if an E is detected, then it must be an EDTA blood sample
         edta = ifelse(str_detect(col1, "E") | str_detect(col2, "E") | str_detect(col3, "E") | str_detect(col4, "E"), "yes", "no"),
         # if a FP is detected, then it must be a "Feather Primary" sample collected
         primary = ifelse(str_detect(col1, "FP") | str_detect(col2, "FP") | str_detect(col3, "FP") | str_detect(col4, "FP"), "yes", "no"),
         # if a FB is detected, then it must be a "Feather Breast" sample collected
         breast = ifelse(str_detect(col1, "FB") | str_detect(col2, "FB") | str_detect(col3, "FB") | str_detect(col4, "FB"), "yes", "no"),
         # if a B is detected, then it is likely a filter paper sample collected
         filter = ifelse(str_detect(col4, "B"), "yes", "no")) %>% 
  # drop the split columns
  select(-c(col1, col2, col3, col4)) %>% 
  mutate(queens = ifelse(is.na(queens), "no", queens),
         edta = ifelse(is.na(edta), "no", edta),
         primary = ifelse(is.na(primary), "no", primary),
         breast = ifelse(is.na(breast), "no", breast),
         filter = ifelse(is.na(filter), "no", filter)) %>% 
  mutate(breast = ifelse(breast == "yes" & age == "J", "no", breast),
         filter = ifelse(sample == "FB" & age == "J", "yes", filter)) %>% 
  mutate(
    Detail9 = "blood sample",
    Units9 = "yes / no",
    Data9 = ifelse(queens == "yes" | edta == "yes" | filter == "yes", "yes", "no"),
    Detail10 = "feather sample",
    Units10 = "yes / no",
    Data10 = ifelse(primary == "yes" | breast == "yes", "yes", "no"),
    Project_Name = "DOC Mobile Threatened Species Research Programme: Banded dotterel flyways project",
    Species_Group = "Waders",
    OtherDetail1 = "", 
    OtherDetailUnit1 = "", 
    OtherDetailData1 = ""
  ) 
```

# Preparing the used and available colour-combo sheets

Load latest version of the marked_bdots_xxx_20xx.xlsx file (see chunk above for the generation of this)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
BADO_banding <- 
  read_xlsx(path = here("data/marked_bdots_Mar_2025_.xlsx"),
            col_types = "text", 
            sheet = 1)  %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.POSIXct(as.Date(as.numeric(Date), origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "Pacific/Auckland"))
```

wrangle the combos into the XX.XX\|XX.XX format (which is used by the combo_matrix_generateR function)

```{r}
BADO_banding_combo_data <- 
  BADO_banding %>% 
  filter(nchar(Left_tarsus) >= 3) %>% 
  select(Prefix, Number, Sex, Locality_general, Left_tibia, Left_tarsus, Right_tibia, Right_tarsus) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Left_tibia, Left_tarsus, Right_tibia, Right_tarsus), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "XX", .)))%>%
  mutate(across(c(Left_tibia, Left_tarsus, Right_tibia, Right_tarsus), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "LG", "L") %>% str_replace_all("/", "") %>% str_replace_all("\\*", "M") %>% str_replace_all("FW", "XX") %>% str_replace_all("FO", "XX"))) %>% 
  mutate(ring = paste0(Prefix, Number),
         code = paste0(Left_tarsus, "-", Right_tarsus))
```

Check that the codes only contain the following characters: B, G, R, O, W, L, Y, X

```{r}
# function to determine which characters have been used in the color combos
find.characters <- function(v1)
{
  x1 <- unique(unlist(strsplit(v1, '')))
  indx <- grepl('[A-Z]', x1)
  c(sort(x1[indx]), sort(x1[!indx]))
}

# Run the function on the data to see which characters are being used in the combo string
find.characters(as.character(BADO_banding_combo_data$code))
```

### quick grabs of all used combos for a given population (e.g., to send as line in an email)

with "R" in the upper left tarsus position (e.g., for Kaikoura)

```{r}
used_RX_adult_codes <- 
  BADO_banding_combo_data[which(grepl("[[R]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}\\-[[GROWLYB]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}", BADO_banding_combo_data$code)),]

used_RX_adult_codes$code %>% sort() %>% unique() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
```

with "Y" in the upper left tarsus position and "Y" or "O" in the lower left tarsus position (e.g., for the Cass)

```{r}
used_YY_adult_codes <- 
  BADO_banding_combo_data[which(grepl("[[Y]{1}[[YO]{1}\\-[[GROWLYB]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}", BADO_banding_combo_data$code)),]

used_YY_adult_codes$code %>% sort() %>% unique() %>% paste(collapse = ", ")
```

### function to compile the combo matrix for a given population

```{r}
combo_matrix_generateR <- 
  function(upper_left_tarsus, 
           lower_left_tarsus = c("B", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y")){
    if(is.null(lower_left_tarsus)){
      combo_grepl <- 
        paste0("[[", upper_left_tarsus, 
               "]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}\\-[[GROWLYB]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}")
      lower_left_tarsus
      }
    else{
      combo_grepl <- 
        paste0("[[", upper_left_tarsus, "]{1}[[", 
               paste0(lower_left_tarsus, collapse = ""), 
               "]{1}\\-[[GROWLYB]{1}[[GROWLYB]{1}")
      }

  # subset data to include all combos for the color specified in the upper_left_tarsus 
  # and lower_left_tarsus positions (see if else above)
  BADO_banding_combo_data_pop <- 
    BADO_banding_combo_data[which(grepl(combo_grepl, BADO_banding_combo_data$code)), ]

  #### Build empty color combo template ----
  
  # Create an empty data frame for all potential color combos given the p
  # opulation-specific combos specified above
  rings <- c("B", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y")
  xx <- as.data.frame(array(, c(8, 8)))
  names(xx) <- c("col", "B", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y")
  xx$col <- c("", "B", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y")
  xx[1,] <- c("", "B", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y")
  yy <- 
    data.frame(code=c(paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'B-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'G-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'R-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'O-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'W-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'L-XX'),
                      paste0(upper_left_tarsus, 'Y-XX')), 
                      id <- 1:7) %>% 
    filter(str_sub(code, 2, 2) %in% lower_left_tarsus)
  
  zz <- merge(yy, xx, all.x=T, all.y=T); zz <- zz[order(zz$id),]
  
  if(nrow(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop) == 0){
    zz1 <-
    zz[-1,-2] %>% 
    rename(right_tarsus = col,
           left_tarsus = code,
           bot____B = B,
           bot____G = G,
           bot____R = R,
           bot____O = O,
           bot____W = W,
           bot___LG = L,
           bot____Y = Y) %>% 
    mutate(right_tarsus = ifelse(str_detect(right_tarsus, "[BGROWLY]{1}"), paste0("top____", right_tarsus), "")) %>%
    mutate(right_tarsus = ifelse(right_tarsus == "top____L", "top___LG", right_tarsus)) %>%
    mutate(left_tarsus = ifelse(right_tarsus == "", "", left_tarsus)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____B = ifelse(bot____B == "B", "bot____B", bot____B)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____G = ifelse(bot____G == "G", "bot____G", bot____G)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____R = ifelse(bot____R == "R", "bot____R", bot____R)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____O = ifelse(bot____O == "O", "bot____O", bot____O)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____W = ifelse(bot____W == "W", "bot____W", bot____W)) %>% 
    mutate(bot___LG = ifelse(bot___LG == "L", "bot___LG", bot___LG)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____Y = ifelse(bot____Y == "Y", "bot____Y", bot____Y))
    
    print(zz1)
  }
  else{
  
  #### Preliminary checks of data ----
  # Check if multiple color combinations were associated with individual metal rings
  ring <- unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring)
  for(i in ring){
    ss <- length(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%i]))
    if(ss>1){cat(i, as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%i])), '\n')}}
  
  # check the number of birds banded with the same combo
  cr <- table(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring, BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code)
  for (i in 1:ncol(cr)){
    x <- sum(cr[,i]>0)
    if(x>2){cat(dimnames(cr)[[2]][i], ' - ', x, '\n')}}
  
  # List of individual color combinations in the data frame
  code <- as.character(sort(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code))) %>% sort()
  length(code)
  
  # These lines will only check if number of full combinations is equal to the 
  # number of total color combinations in the capture files. This is only used 
  # for a check in the end, to see if all color combos were included in the color 
  # combo sheets
  fc0 <- 0; FC <- c() # number of full combos; list of full combos
  
  for(i in code){
    # split combo by position
    r1 <- str_sub(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[1], 1, 1) # W
    r2 <- str_sub(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[1], 2, 2) # W
    r3 <- str_sub(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[2], 1, 1) # R
    r4 <- str_sub(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[2], 2, 2) # O
  
    # if colors in all 4 positions are included in the "rings" (see line 14)
    if( sum(c(r1,r2,r3,r4) %in% rings) == 4){  
      if("M" %in% c(r1,r2,r3,r4)){fc0 <- fc0+1; FC <- c(FC, i)}}}
  
  fc0 == length(code) # number of combos = number of full combos
  # IT NEEDS CHECKS IF ITS FALSE - it means that some combinations might not be 
  # included in the color combo sheet
  
  #### Build the table of used combos ----
  # reset
  fc <- 0; FC <- c()
  
  # extract unique codes from capture data
  code <- as.character(sort(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code)))
  
  for(i in code){
    # extract the combo on each leg segment
    # E.g. "WX.RB|MX.YB"
    r1 <- substr(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[1], 1, 1) # R
    r2 <- substr(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[1], 2, 2) # B
    r3 <- substr(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[2], 1, 1) # Y
    r4 <- substr(unlist(strsplit(i, "[-]"))[2], 2, 2) # B
    
    if( sum(c(r1, r2, r3, r4)%in%rings) == 4){
        {fc <- fc + 1; FC <- c(FC, i)}}
  
        codei <- paste(upper_left_tarsus, r2, '-', 'XX', sep='')
      if(length(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i]))==1){
        R1 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i]))
        zz[zz$code%in%codei & zz$col%in%r3, names(zz)%in%r4] <-
          paste(R1, unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R1]),sep='_')}
      
      if(length(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i]))==2){
        R1 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i])[1])
        R2 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i])[2])
        zz[zz$code%in%codei & zz$col%in%r3, names(zz)%in%r4] <- 
          paste(paste(R1,unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R1]),sep='_'), 
                paste(R2,unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R2]),sep='_'), sep=', ') } 
      
      if(length(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i]))==3){
        R1 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i])[1])
        R2 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i])[2])
        R3 <- as.character(unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$code%in% i])[3])
        zz[zz$code%in%codei & zz$col%in%r3, names(zz)%in%r4] <- 
          paste(  paste(R1,unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R1]),sep='_'), 
                  paste(R2,unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R2]),sep='_'),
                  paste(R3,unique(BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$Sex[BADO_banding_combo_data_pop$ring%in%R3]),sep='_'), sep=', ') }}#}
  
  # remove the first row and first column
  zz1 <- zz[-1,-2]; head(zz1)
  
  #### Final checks ----
  # Check the head of the spreadsheet
  head(zz)
  
  # check one of the blocks to check (in this case birds with RB)
  # filter(zz1, code == "RB|M.XX")
  filter(zz1, code == "BW-XX")
  
  # check that all combos are included in the sheet
  zz2 <- zz1[!zz1$col %in%"" ,]
  zzFC <- c()
  for (i in 1:nrow(zz2)){
    for(j in 3:ncol(zz2)){
      c <- zz2[i,j]
      if(!is.na(c) & !is.na(zz2$col[i])) {
        cd  <- sub("X", names(zz2)[j], sub("X", zz2$col[i], zz2$code[i]))
        cd1 <- paste(strsplit(cd, NULL)[[1]][1], 
                     strsplit(cd, NULL)[[1]][2],
                     "-", #strsplit(cd, NULL)[[1]][4], "X.", 
                     strsplit(cd, NULL)[[1]][4], 
                     strsplit(cd, NULL)[[1]][5], sep='')
        zzFC <- c(zzFC, cd1)}}}
  
  # IF TRUE THE NUMBER OF FULL COMBOS IN CAPTURE FILE IS EQUAL TO THE NUMBER OF 
  # FULL COMBOS IN THE CREATED DATA FILE --> ALL GOOD!!!
  length(zzFC) == fc
  
  # IF THE PREVIOUS STATEMENT IS FALSE -> CHECKS ARE NEEDED
  # The following two objects should both be empty if all is good:
  
  # combinations that are included in the combo sheet but are not found in the capture file
  # zzFC[ !zzFC%in%str_sub(FC, 4, 11)]
  setdiff(zzFC, FC)
  
  # combinations that are in the capture file but were not included in the combo sheet
  setdiff(FC, zzFC)
  
  # number of full combinations in the capture file are equal to the number of combos in the combo sheet
  length(zzFC) == fc0 
  
  zz1 <-
    zz1 %>% 
    rename(right_tarsus = col,
           left_tarsus = code,
           bot____B = B,
           bot____G = G,
           bot____R = R,
           bot____O = O,
           bot____W = W,
           bot___LG = L,
           bot____Y = Y) %>% 
    mutate(right_tarsus = ifelse(str_detect(right_tarsus, "[BGROWLY]{1}"), paste0("top____", right_tarsus), "")) %>%
    mutate(right_tarsus = ifelse(right_tarsus == "top____L", "top___LG", right_tarsus)) %>%
    mutate(left_tarsus = ifelse(right_tarsus == "", "", left_tarsus)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____B = ifelse(bot____B == "B", "bot____B", bot____B)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____G = ifelse(bot____G == "G", "bot____G", bot____G)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____R = ifelse(bot____R == "R", "bot____R", bot____R)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____O = ifelse(bot____O == "O", "bot____O", bot____O)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____W = ifelse(bot____W == "W", "bot____W", bot____W)) %>% 
    mutate(bot___LG = ifelse(bot___LG == "L", "bot___LG", bot___LG)) %>% 
    mutate(bot____Y = ifelse(bot____Y == "Y", "bot____Y", bot____Y))
  
  print(zz1)
  }}
```

# Wrangle leg markings into the "btocodes" format for BirdMark

#### import the latest excel sheet detailing all the combos available

```{r}
BADO_banding <- 
  read_xlsx(path = here("data/marked_bdots_Mar_2025_.xlsx"),
            col_types = "text", 
            sheet = 1)  %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.POSIXct(as.Date(as.numeric(Date), origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "Pacific/Auckland"))
```

```{r}
btocodes <-
  BADO_banding %>% 
  select("Prefix", "Number", "Locality_general", "Sex", "Age", "Left_tibia",  "Left_tarsus", "Right_tibia", "Right_tarsus") %>%
  mutate(LA = Left_tibia,
        LB = Left_tarsus,
        RA = Right_tibia, 
        RB = Right_tarsus) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(Left_tibia, Left_tarsus, Right_tibia, Right_tarsus),
    ~ str_replace_all(., c(
        "LG" = "L",
        "\\*" = "M",
        "FW" = "WF",
        "FO" = "OF",
        "/" = ",",
        ",X" = "",  # Remove "/X"
        "X," = ""   # Remove "X/"
      ))
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Left_tibia = ifelse(!is.na(Left_tibia), paste0("LA", Left_tibia), NA),
    Left_tarsus = ifelse(!is.na(Left_tarsus), paste0("LB", Left_tarsus), NA),
    Right_tibia = ifelse(!is.na(Right_tibia), paste0("RA", Right_tibia), NA),
    Right_tarsus = ifelse(!is.na(Right_tarsus), paste0("RL", Right_tarsus), NA)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(btocodes = paste(na.omit(c(Left_tibia, Left_tarsus, Right_tibia, Right_tarsus)), collapse = ";")) %>% 
  mutate(nchar_ = nchar(btocodes)) %>% 
  filter(nchar_ > 7) %>% 
  select(Prefix, Number, Sex, Age, btocodes) %>% 
  mutate(Age = ifelse(Age == "P", "J", Age)) %>% 
  rbind(data.frame(Prefix = "none", 
                   Number = "none", 
                   Sex = "F", 
                   Age = "A", 
                   btocodes = "RAWF(2K)"))
btocodes

write.xlsx(btocodes, 
           file = here("data/btocodes_07Apr25.xlsx"), 
           sheetName = "Sheet1", 
           rowNames = FALSE)
```

# Exploring Argos data
### import and check Argos data
```{r}
# import sensor data for tags collected prior to Jan 9, 2025
argos_sensor_data_pre_jan_9_2025 <- 
  bind_rows(read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_19_57_56.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_19_58_31.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_19_59_05.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_19_59_42.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_00_15.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_00_47.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_01_20.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_01_43.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_02_10.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            read.csv("/Users/leberhart/ownCloud/kemp_projects/bdot/R_projects/bdot_db/data/argos/ArgosData_2025_03_17_20_02_34.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)) %>% 
  rename(tagID = Platform.ID.No.,
         locationDate = Loc..date,
         bestMsgDate = Msg.Date,
         `SENSOR #1` = SENSOR.01,
         `SENSOR #2` = SENSOR.02, 
         `SENSOR #3` = SENSOR.03, 
         `SENSOR #4` = SENSOR.04, 
         `SENSOR #5` = SENSOR.05, 
         `SENSOR #6` = SENSOR.06, 
         `SENSOR #7` = SENSOR.07, 
         `SENSOR #8` = SENSOR.08) %>% 
  dplyr::select(tagID,  locationDate, `SENSOR #1`, `SENSOR #2`, `SENSOR #3`, `SENSOR #4`, `SENSOR #5`, `SENSOR #6`, `SENSOR #7`, `SENSOR #8`) %>% 
  mutate(locationDate = as.POSIXct(locationDate, tz = "UTC"),
         tagID = as.character(tagID)) %>% 
  mutate(locationDate = with_tz(locationDate, tzone = 'Pacific/Auckland'))

argos_sensor_data_pre_jan_9_2025 %>% 
  filter(tagID == "266447")

# connect to database
con = dbcon()
dbExecute(con, "USE FIELD_2024_BADOatNZ")

argos_2024 <-
  
  # Load ARGOS data from the 2024_BADO table of the ARGOS2 database
  dbq(q = "SELECT * FROM ARGOS2.2024_BADO") %>%
  
  # Convert locationDate timezone to 'Pacific/Auckland'
  mutate(locationDate = with_tz(locationDate, tzone = 'Pacific/Auckland')) %>%
  
  # Remove duplicate rows
  distinct() %>%
  
  # Ensure tagID is a character
  mutate(tagID = as.character(tagID)) %>%
  
  # Join with ARGOS sensor data
  full_join(
    dbq(con, "SELECT * FROM ARGOS2.sensors") %>%
      filter(platformId %in% (
        dbq(con, "SELECT * FROM CAPTURES") %>%
          pull(tag_id) %>%
          unique()
      )) %>%
      
      # Reshape from long to wide format
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = sensor_info, 
        values_from = sensor_value
      ) %>%
      
      # Rename and adjust formats
      rename(locationDate = timestamp,
             tagID = platformId) %>%
      mutate(locationDate = with_tz(locationDate, tzone = 'Pacific/Auckland'),
             tagID = as.character(tagID)) %>%
      
      # Drop unnecessary columns
      select(-c(sensor_id, pk)) %>%
      
      # Aggregate by tagID and timestamp, taking max value of each SENSOR
      group_by(tagID, locationDate) %>%
      summarise(across(starts_with("SENSOR"), ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>% 
      bind_rows(argos_sensor_data_pre_jan_9_2025), 
    
    by = c("tagID", "locationDate")
  ) %>% 
  
  # Calculate derived sensor metrics: temperature, voltage, and acceleration
  mutate(
    temp = ifelse(is.infinite(`SENSOR #1`), NA, (0.474 * `SENSOR #1`) - 35.662),
    volt = ifelse(is.infinite(`SENSOR #2`), NA, (0.0079 * `SENSOR #2`) + 2.4129),
    acc  = `SENSOR #4`
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename tagID "266470" based on date (re-deployment split into A and B)
  mutate(tagID = ifelse(
    tagID == "266470" & locationDate < as.POSIXct("2024-12-09 17:38:00", tz = 'Pacific/Auckland'), 
    "266470_A", 
    ifelse(
      tagID == "266470" & locationDate >= as.POSIXct("2024-12-09 17:38:00", tz = 'Pacific/Auckland'), 
      "266470_B", 
      tagID
    )
  )) %>%
  
  # Join with CAPTURES table to get deployment times
  left_join(
    dbq(con, "SELECT * FROM CAPTURES") %>%
      filter(nchar(tag_id) == 6) %>%                        # Keep only 6-digit tags
      rename(tagID = tag_id) %>%
      group_by(tagID) %>%
      
      # Get latest known time from cap_start, caught, or released
      mutate(time = as_hms(max(cap_start, caught, released, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
      
      # Create full timestamp of deployment
      mutate(time_deployed = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = 'Pacific/Auckland')) %>%
      
      # Again, rename 266470 to A or B based on ring ID
      mutate(tagID = ifelse(tagID == "266470" & ring == "CP19334", "266470_A", 
                            ifelse(tagID == "266470" & ring == "CP16667", "266470_B", tagID)))  %>% 

      # clean up the leg marking columns to a) remove erroneous white space
      mutate(across(c(UL, LL, UR, LR), ~ gsub("[,[:space:]]", "", .))) %>%
        
      # put an X in all leg-mark cases that are blank
      mutate(across(c(UL, LL, UR, LR), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "", "X", .))) %>%
        
      # put an "FW" in front of all text that is not X, M, FO, or starting with FW in the UL and UR positions 
      mutate(across(c(UL, UR), ~ ifelse(. %in% c("X", "M", "FO", "G", "R", "O", "W", "L", "Y") | grepl("^FW", .) | is.na(.), ., paste0("FW", .)))) %>%
        
      # put a note in the ring field for the two birds that didn't get a metal band
      mutate(ring = ifelse(str_detect(UR, "FW2K") & pk == 23, "missing_metal_FW2K", ring)) %>% 
        
      mutate(UR = ifelse(UR == "FWFO", "FO", UR)) %>% 
      
      mutate(mark = ifelse(LL == "X" & LR == "X" & UL == "M", UR, 
                           ifelse(LL == "X" & LR == "X" & UR == "M", UL, 
                                  ifelse(LL == "X" & LR == "X" & UR != "M", UR, paste(LL, "-", LR))))) %>% 
      
      # Keep only relevant columns
      select(tagID, ring, site, field_sex, mark, time_deployed), 
    by = "tagID"
  ) %>% 
  
  # Keep only rows with a valid location date
  filter(!is.na(locationDate)) %>%
  
  distinct() %>% 
  
  # Only include ARGOS locations after the tag was deployed
  filter(locationDate >= time_deployed) %>%
  
  # Drop time_deployed after filtering
  select(-time_deployed) %>%
  
  # Keep only relevant columns for final output
  select(
    tagID, ring, site, field_sex, mark, locationDate, latitude, longitude, locationClass, 
    errorRadius, semiMajor, semiMinor, orientation, temp, volt, acc
  ) %>%
  
  # Arrange chronologically by tag
  arrange(tagID, locationDate) %>% 
  
  # remove rows of data that were collected after the death of CP19334 but before the redeployment of the tag on CP16667
  mutate(remove = ifelse(tagID == "266470_A" & locationDate > as.POSIXct("2024-10-12 19:15:00", tz = 'Pacific/Auckland'), "1", 
                         ifelse(tagID == "266470_B" & locationDate < as.POSIXct("2024-12-09 17:38:00", tz = 'Pacific/Auckland'), "1", "0"))) %>% 
  filter(remove == 0) %>% 
  select(-remove) %>% 
  rename(local_date_time = locationDate) %>% 
  mutate(local_date = as.Date(local_date_time))
```

### summarise Argos data: daily fix rate, daily temperature, daily activity
```{r}
argos_2024_daily_fix_rate <- 
  argos_2024 %>% 
  group_by(tagID, site, ring, field_sex, mark, local_date) %>% 
  mutate(lag_acc = lag(acc) - acc) %>%
  summarise(n_fixes = sum(!is.na(latitude)),
            mean_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_lag_acc = mean(lag_acc, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_acc_values = n_distinct(as.character(acc)),
            mean_voltage = mean(volt, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_acc = max(acc, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### plot some tracks
E.g., all tracks since deployment from the Tasman Valley (site == "TS")
```{r}
argos_2024_points <-
  argos_2024 %>% 
  filter(site == "TS") %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude)) %>% 
  filter(latitude < 0 & latitude > -48) %>% 
  filter(locationClass %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ring, tagID, mark, field_sex, latitude, longitude, local_date) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) 

argos_2024_lines <- 
  argos_2024_points  %>% 
  group_by(ring) %>%
  arrange(local_date) %>% 
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

mapview(argos_2024_points, zcol = "ring") + 
  mapview(argos_2024_lines, zcol = "ring", lwd = 2)
```

### temporal variation in daily fix rate
```{r}
ggplot(data = argos_2024_daily_fix_rate) +
  geom_point(aes(x = local_date, y = n_fixes, color = site), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = local_date, y = n_fixes), color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(site + tagID + mark ~ ., ncol = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  ylab("daily number of PTT transmissons")
```
